notes: Day 2: Lost most of its character - tastes like generic coffee. I noticed at DE that many more beans than typiccal were scorched. I don't think it happened near DE, probably closer to charge. Hard to see some of the scorching in the final roast. Roast was quite uneven between beans. Day 5: some nice earthy & cocoa notes coming through. Good brightness, but still lacking any fruitiness - 7/10.
